name: Design and Development of Basic Intelligent Computing Systems 1
description: The course is a basic introduction to a purely hands-on project activity based on the end to end development of an intelligent computing appliance, its software (including OS and user level applications), hardware design (enclosure, PCB, ruggedness testing) based on a COTS platform.
